message: onclick runs inline script; use command and commandfor on buttons, or attach listeners from a script module.
<input type="number"> is labeled only by its placeholder, which disappears on input. Add <label for="…">…</label> (WCAG 1.3.1, 3.3.2).
Link text "Link" doesn’t say where the link goes; describe the destination, such as "Read the pricing guide" (WCAG 2.4.4).
